8: async def checkout(items, discount, pricing, downstream, query, producer):
9:     try: item=choose_item(items)
10:     except ValueError as exc: raise HTTPException(409,'catalog unavailable') from exc
11:     amount=pricing(item['price'],1,discount)
12:     order_id=str(uuid.uuid4())
13:     await downstream('payment-service','/charge',{'order_id':order_id,'amount':amount})
14:     await query('INSERT INTO orders(id,user_id,total) VALUES(%s,1,%s)',(order_id,amount))
15:     carrier={};propagate.inject(carrier)
16:     await producer.send_and_wait('orders',json.dumps({'order_id':order_id,'trace':carrier}).encode())
17:     return {'order_id':order_id,'total':amount}
